svg.title: Location Master guide
svg.desc: A supermarket aisle and a warehouse pallet rack. Sales Floor: Zone S01, Bay B01, Shelf C01 make the Location Code S01-B01-C01. Warehouse: Zone W01, Rack R02, Level C01 make W01-R02-C01. Each product has one Sales Location and one Warehouse Location per Store; moving it to another shelf or cooler keeps them; stock moved between the Warehouse and the Sales Floor is recorded as a Stock Transfer.
svg.text: How a Location Code is built
Each Store names its own places. One code = three parts, from the biggest place to the smallest.
Each product has one Sales Location per Store.
Each product has one Warehouse Location per Store.
Moving it to another shelf or cooler keeps its Location.
Warehouse ↔ Sales Floor moves are Stock Transfers.
